mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sticker ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, code
SELECT code FROM sticker WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, code
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sticker WHERE code = #{code})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sticker (code, name, name_en, svg, image_key, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{nameEn}, #{svg}, #{imageKey}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE sticker SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE code = #{code}
